name: Nation Broadcasting Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Nation Broadcasting Corporation Public Company Limited produces TV programs primarily in Thailand. It also provides advertisements through TV and new media platforms; retails consumer and other products; and engages in the tourism business. In addition, the company sells foods and beverages, including tea, coffee, and bakery products. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand. Nation Broadcasting Corporation Public Company Limited is a subsidiary of Nation Multimedia Group Public Company Limited.
